parrafo_1.es: Samada Fence es un negocio familiar que instala cercas de madera, vinil y aluminio en patios, piscinas y propiedades de todo el sur de Florida, manejando el permiso de la HOA cuando aplica.
parrafo_1.en: Samada Fence is a family-run business installing wood, vinyl and aluminum fencing around yards, pools and properties across South Florida, handling HOA permitting when it applies.

parrafo_2.es: Quienes dejan resenas en Google destacan la mano de obra cuidada, los permisos manejados sin complicaciones y los trabajos terminados a tiempo.
parrafo_2.en: Reviewers on Google point to careful workmanship, permits handled without hassle and jobs finished on time.

texto.es: Medimos tu propiedad y te damos un estimado claro para tu cerca.
texto.en: We measure your property and give you a clear estimate for your fence.

texto.es: Manejamos el permiso y la aprobacion de la HOA cuando aplica.
texto.en: We handle the permit and HOA approval when it applies.

texto.es: Instalamos tu cerca de madera, vinil o aluminio en pocos dias.
texto.en: We install your wood, vinyl or aluminum fence in just a few days.

texto.es: Revisamos cada seccion y puerta contigo antes de terminar.
texto.en: We walk every section and gate with you before calling it done.

nota.es: Cada cerca se cotiza segun el material y el largo de tu propiedad. Llamanos para un estimado gratis.
nota.en: Every fence is quoted based on material and property length. Call us for a free estimate.

texto.es: Cercas de aluminio para piscinas y patios, durables y de bajo mantenimiento.
texto.en: Aluminum fencing for pools and yards, durable and low maintenance.

texto.es: Privacidad y buen acabado alrededor de toda la propiedad.
texto.en: Privacy and a clean finish around the whole property.

texto.es: Cercas de madera clasicas, instaladas y reemplazadas a medida.
texto.en: Classic wood fencing, installed and replaced to size.

texto.es: Manejamos el papeleo del permiso y la aprobacion de la HOA.
texto.en: We handle the permit paperwork and HOA approval.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Llamanos igual, te decimos si podemos ayudar.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Call us anyway and we will tell you if we can help.

items.quote: Samada Fence just finished installing the fence in our backyard. They did a fantastic job! Exceptional workmanship, very experienced installers, listened to all my needs. I'm very happy and impressed. Highly recommend this family business.

I just had my backyard fence done with Samada fence, Sergio was very helpful letting me know the status of the permits. The job was scheduled for the next week and it was completed as promised in two days.
I went with Samada Fence based on reviews on Neighborhood site. It was a chance, but was delighted that they did a great job replacing my old wooden fence. They were very professional.
